description: Password reset request: link creation, email delivery and revocation rules; accounts are not revealed.

cases.log: Audit row UserPasswordResetRequested (details { email }, never the token); log "Password reset for account {UserId} requested by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active account lan@x.vn with a password hash; email transport accepts the message.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG13); a reset link valid for 60 minutes is created, emailed to lan@x.vn and then activated (earlier links stop working); the current password is unchanged.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(NotFound) (HTTP 404, no message code); no link created.

cases.log: Log "Password reset rejected: account {UserId} is deactivated."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetNotAvailable) (MSG14); no link created and no email sent.

cases.log: Log "Password reset rejected: account {UserId} has no password."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Active account with no password hash (signs in with Google only).
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetNotAvailable) (MSG14); no link created and no email sent.

cases.inputs: id: active account with a password.
cases.log: Warning log "Password reset for account {UserId} could not be emailed."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Email transport cannot deliver the message.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetEmailFailed) (MSG15); the new link is never activated, so a link sent earlier keeps working; no audit row.

cases.log: Link revoked (log "Password reset link for account {UserId} revoked: ..."); audit row UserPasswordResetRequested with the old email.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
While the email is being sent another administrator changes the account email from lan@x.vn to moi@x.vn.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG13): the email did go out, but the just-activated link is revoked because the address it went to is no longer the account's.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
While the email is being sent another administrator deactivates the account.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG13); the just-activated link is revoked because the account is no longer active.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
While the email is being sent the account email changes only in letter case (lan@x.vn to LAN@x.vn).
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG13); the link is not revoked: a case change is the same mailbox.

precondition: Active and deactivated users seeded; reset email sender replaced by a recorder.
